senses.gloss:
(ञ्) भृञ् r. 1st cl. (भरति-ते) (डु ञ्) डुभृञ् r. 3rd cl. (विभर्त्ति विभृते)
1 To nourish, to cherish, to foster, to maintain.
2 To fill.
3 To hold or support.

r. 9th cl. (भृणाति^1)
1 To blame or censure.
2 To nourish, to maintain, to support.
3 To hold.
4 To fry.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320. note: cf wil1819, mw.
